name: Databricks
summary: Databricks is a US data and AI company. It makes AI models, such as [DBRX](https://techcrunch.com/2024/04/24/snowflake-releases-a-flagship-generative-ai-model-of-its-own/).

incidents.title: Researchers Show Malicious Skills Can Make Databricks Genie Code Leak Data and Phish Users
incidents.summary: [PromptArmor reported](https://www.promptarmor.com/resources/phishing-in-databricks-genie) that Databricks' Genie Code agent ran code from a malicious Skill that sent a user's tenant data to an attacker's server and showed a phishing window, and that its guardrail agent approved the code. PromptArmor said Databricks called vetting uploaded Skills the user's responsibility.
incidents.description: [PromptArmor reported](https://www.promptarmor.com/resources/phishing-in-databricks-genie) that Databricks' Genie Code agent ran code from a malicious Skill. Reportedly, the code sent a user's tenant data to an attacker's server and showed a phishing window, and the guardrail agent approved it. According to PromptArmor, Databricks said that the user is responsible for checking uploaded Skills.

timeline.title: PromptArmor publishes the attack chain
timeline.description: PromptArmor publishes the attack chain and Databricks' reply that the risk is the user's responsibility ([PromptArmor](https://www.promptarmor.com/resources/phishing-in-databricks-genie)).
